stem: Which sentence best supports the author's belief that living alone is an appealing choice for many people?

options.label: F
options.text: The theme of declining communities entered popular culture with Bowling Alone, political scientist Robert D. Putnam's book, which was published in 2000.

options.label: G
options.text: The extraordinary rise of solitary living is the biggest social change that we've neglected to identify . . .

options.label: H
options.text: Living alone, being alone and feeling lonely are hardly the same . . .

options.label: J
options.text: Today, in our age of digital media and ever expanding social networks, living alone can offer even greater benefits: the time and space for restorative solitude.
